subject: Follow-up: ramp and commit options qualification
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Grant <elliot@lumify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo notes + quick ask on volumes and budget

Hi Elliot — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can put a concrete discount proposal in front of procurement.

Recap (what we heard on the call):
- Primary use case: in-product summarization + search for end users (high short-context completions; avg request 450 tokens).
- Expected ramp: P0 pilot 1–2 months (~10M tokens/mo), ramp to steady state 6–9 months (~80–120M tokens/mo).
- Current budget signal: $7–10k/mo during pilot, engineering budget can expand if unit economics justify.
- Timeline: pilot in July; procurement/PO target mid-August if pilot metrics look good.

Two quick asks so we can model and propose:
1) Confirm if the 80–120M tokens/mo steady-state is the right 6–9mo target (we modeled both 80M and 120M scenarios in the attached).
2) What target $/1M tokens would make a committed-use path attractive to you (ballpark is fine — e.g., $50, $40, $30 per 1M tokens)? This drives which starter tier / multi-year sweetener we propose.

Attached: lumify_burn_model.xlsx (we populated based on your call notes) and a short PDF with starter-tier definitions.

If you confirm the two items above, Ben will send a 3-scenario commitment proposal (pilot-friendly, 12-mo committed, 24-mo multi-year).

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: lumify_burn_model.xlsx (spreadsheet, 58KB), redwood-starter-tiers.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

From: Elliot Grant <elliot@lumify.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@lumify.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo notes + quick ask on volumes and budget

Kim — thanks for the clear recap and for the model. Quick clarifications: 

- Confirmed steady-state: our internal roadmap expects ~90M tokens/mo at 6 months and a stretch target of 130M at 9–12 months if adoption accelerates. 90M is the conservative baseline.
- Target $/1M: internal stakeholders would be happy to see proposals that hit ~$35–45/1M as a target for committed discounts; pilot rates can be higher but we'd want clear glide path.
- Procurement: we are a bit particular about payment terms (Net30) and need a simple SOW showing data residency and audit controls.

Procurement loop: procure@lumify.ai will own the PO. They asked that the commercial proposal include: (1) clear monthly token bands, (2) replacement/rollover policy for unused committed tokens, and (3) a short note on support/uptime SLA.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call tomorrow if that helps speed alignment.

—Elliot
Elliot Grant
Head of Product, Lumify

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 4:12 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elliot — thanks again for the demo earlier...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Grant <elliot@lumify.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo notes + quick ask on volumes and budget — proposed scenarios

Elliot / procure team — thanks for the clarity. Based on the 90M baseline and the $35–45/1M target band, we sketched three practical commercial scenarios (high-level). See summary below and attached PDF quote.

Scenario A — Pilot-first (low friction)
- Duration: 3 months pilot (month-to-month)
- Rate: Hosted pay-as-you-go = $95 / 1M tokens for the pilot (no commitment)
- Post-pilot: option to convert to Scenario B or C with pro-rata credit for pilot spend

Scenario B — 12-month commitment (recommended conservative)
- Committed monthly band: 40M tokens/mo (min) with step-up to 90M by month 6
- Effective rate (blended): $48 / 1M tokens assuming 12-mo ramp (see attached model)
- Replacement policy: unused committed tokens roll into a 3-mo grace pool; beyond that, standard rollover is not available

Scenario C — 24-month multi-year (best unit econ)
- Committed monthly band: 80M tokens/mo initial, 130M target by month 12
- Effective rate: $33 / 1M tokens with a 10% upfront commit credit and 6% multi-year sweetener applied at year 2
- Add-on: Founders sponsorship credit (one-time $10k credit) available for proof-of-value customers that sign within 45 days

Key notes:
- We can structure Net30 invoices for all committed deals.
- SLA and a short SOW note can be included in the commercial pack; we will call out data-residency options for your region.
- We included an optional escrow-like prepayment mechanism in Scenario C to secure slot capacity; details in the attached PDF.

Attachments: redwood-commit-proposal-lumify.pdf (proposal, 5 pages)

Next suggested step: confirm you want a formal quote for Scenario B vs C — we can turn a DocuSign-ready agreement around in 48 hours once you pick lanes.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Elliot Grant <elliot@lumify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@lumify.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo notes + quick ask on volumes and budget — proposed scenarios

Ben / Kim — appreciate the fast turnaround and the three clear lanes. Lumify procurement prefers Scenario C from a cost perspective (the $33/1M blended looks nearest our target), but we need the following clarified before legal/procurement will proceed:

1) Confirmation of rollover/grace pool behavior and exact timing for the 3-mo grace; we prefer some limited rollover for seasonality.
2) Sample SOW snippet covering data residency + SOC2 evidence reference.
3) Can the founders $10k credit be structured as an upfront reduction on the first invoice? Procurement likes simple line-item credits.

If you can get those three items into a revised quote, we will route to legal and ask for a standard PO (targeting mid-August). Happy for a 20-min call Thurs if any of this is faster to resolve.

Thanks — Elliot
Elliot Grant
Head of Product, Lumify

Attachments includedinline: redwood-commit-proposal-lumify.pdf (proposal summary, 5 pages).
